description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function declarations for a logic expression evaluation module used in firmware. It includes classes for expression elements, a calculator, and utilities for parsing and evaluating logical expressions related to engine parameters.

classes.name: LEElement
classes.description: Represents an element of a logical expression, storing an action and values, and linked to other elements.

classes.name: LEElementPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of LEElement objects, facilitating parsing of expressions.

classes.name: LECalculator
classes.description: Performs calculation and evaluation of logical expressions composed of LEElements.

classes.name: LENameOrdinalPair
classes.description: Associates a name with an action, used in expression parsing or evaluation context.

methods.name: LEElement
methods.description: Constructor for LEElement.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the LEElement to default state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the LEElement with specified action and optional values.

methods.name: LEElementPool
methods.description: Constructor for LEElementPool.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next available LEElement from the pool.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the pool to initial state.

methods.name: parseExpression
methods.description: Parses a string line into an expression represented by LEElements.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the pool.

methods.name: LECalculator
methods.description: Constructor for LECalculator.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Calculates the value of an expression, potentially considering engine parameters.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an LEElement to the calculator for evaluation.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no elements to evaluate.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the calculator state.

methods.name: getValue2
methods.description: Calculates value with a specified first element in the list.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an action and value onto the calculation stack.

methods.name: processElement
methods.description: Processes an individual expression element during evaluation.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Pops a value from the evaluation stack.

methods.name: LENameOrdinalPair
methods.description: Constructor linking a name to an action.

methods.name: getNextToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token from a line into a buffer.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a line represents a numeric value.

methods.name: parseAction
methods.description: Parses a line to determine the logical action represented.

methods.name: float2bool
methods.description: Converts a float to a boolean value.
